svg.font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
svg.title: An alias route
svg.desc: Requests to the alias fast whose x-plan header is paid go to Claude Sonnet, which falls back to GPT-5 when it fails. Every other request is split by caller, 90 percent to Claude Haiku and 10 percent to GPT-5 mini.
